content:wysiwyg_basic:2:32.html:
Women's Auxiliary

The Women’s Auxiliary is a civic group of over 100 community-minded women who want to make a difference in Savannah, GA, and the surrounding counties by raising awareness and funds to expand the amount and quality of help that is given by The Salvation Army of Savannah.

2021-2022 Officers

Krissy Williams, President

Marsha Scott, Vice President

Mary Ann Hogan, Treasurer

Sandi Page, Membership Committee Chair

Carol Downs, Nominating Committee Chair

Mary Redding, Finance Committee Chair

Dianne Brown, Public Relation Committee Chair

Sharyn Baggett, Family Boutique Committee Chair

Gail DeLoach & Sharon Wilkerson, Christmas Committee Co-Chairs

Carol Grable, Hospitality Committee Chair
